title: Job Application and CV / Icelo Lokusebenza ne-CV
bridge: NesiNgisi, sisebenzisa isikhathi nge-‘have’ kanti ngeZulu sisebenzisa ‘ngina’ okanye ‘ngine’. Qaphela ukusebenzisa ‘experience’ (hhayi ‘experiences’) kanye nokuhloba kweshajeni ngaphambi komsila, okungokwemibalo ngeZulu. Hamba kahle ukuhumusha ‘me dedico a’ njengokuthi ‘ngiyakhiqiza’, kanti ngeZulu sisebenzisa ‘ngisebenza njengokuthi’ okanye ‘ngiyaphakeme ngokuthi’.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngesebenza sakho ngeZulu ehleli B1: 1) Sebenzisa isikhathi samanje ukudonsa umsebenzi wakho: ‘Ngisebenza njengokuthi...’ (Ngisebenza njengokuthi...), ‘Ngiyaphakeme ngokuthi...’ (Ngiyaphakeme ngokuthi...). 2) Ukusebenza kwakho kwakudlule, sebenzisa ‘used to’ okanye isikhathi sakudlule: ‘Ngase ngisebenza e...’ / ‘Ngisebenza e...’. 3) Isebenza ‘have’ ukudonsa ubudala nokubeka izikhono: ‘Ngine iminyaka engama-5 yengojini’ (Ngine iminyaka engama-5 yengojini). 4) Izishajeni ziyaphambi komsila: ‘Ngine izikhono eziqondile zokukhuluma’ (hhayi ‘izikhono eziqondile’). 5) Sebenzisa ‘in’ ezikhundleni zezinhlangano (‘experience in hospitality’), ‘at’ ezikhundleni zezinkampani (‘at a hotel’), kanye ‘as’ ezikhundleni zezinhlobo zezinkampani (‘as a manager’). 6) E-CV, sebenzisa amakhasi kanye nezwi zokudlule okanye zamanje, hhayi izinkomba ezifana.

title: Discussing current events / Khuluma ngamaqembu namathuba asezikhathini
bridge: NgesiSpani, sivela ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana noma esedlule ukutellahla izindaba, kanti ngezisiZulu, kunzima ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana (ngokwesibonelo 'has happened') kanye nesikhathi esedlule (ngokwesibonelo 'happened') ukutellahla izindaba ezisodwa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izikhathi eziqhubekayo (ngokwesibonelo 'is happening') zisebenzisa kaningi ngesiZulu ukutellahla izindaba eziqhubekayo. Igama eliphulwa ngokuvamile ukubhala ngokwesiNgesi 'is happening' ngokwenhloso yokuthi 'is happening' lapho kanti ngesiZulu sisetshenziselwa isikhathi esihambisana ukutellahla izindaba eziqhubekayo.
rule: Ukutellahla izindaba ngesiZulu ehlekelweni B1: 1. Sebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana (have/has + isiphethi) ukutellahla izindaba ezisodwa ngaphandle kokuchaza isikhathi esihle: 'Abafundi bafumene isikhungo esisha.' 2. Sebenzisa isikhathi esedlule ukutellahla izindaba ezinomkhathi oqinisekile: 'Bathandaza igama ngomhla weshomi.' 3. Sebenzisa isikhathi esiqhubekayo ukutellahla izindaba eziqhubekayo manje: 'Umphakathi uyaqhubeka ukudlulisela umthetho omusha.' 4. Ukubeka izinqumo, sebenzisa amazwi njengokuthi 'Ngiyakholelwa', 'Ngokwami', 'Ngiyakholelwa' elandelela isigaba. 5. Amazwi okukhomba: 'isikhalo', 'isibhalo', 'inhlaka', 'ngokwesibonelo', 'okusodwa', 'isihloko'.

title: Cultural Differences and Misunderstandings / Imiphakanyiswa nokubhekana kwezindaba ezahlukahlukene
bridge: Ngesi, siyavuma ukukhuluma ngokucophelela okanye ukuxhumana ngendlela engakaphambili, kanti nge-English kukhona ukusetshenziswa kweluleko olungakaphambili nokukhuluma ngokwenhlonipho, njengokuthi 'I think...' okanye 'Maybe...'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, nge-English, ukubhekana kwezinye izinto kuhlanganiswa ngokubuza imibuzo yokukhakisisa ('Do you mean...?'), kanti ngesi kukhona ukusebenzisa okuningi ukuqinisekisa okanye ukuphendula. Ukuze kuhambe kahle, kudingeka ukufunda ukubiza izimpendulo ngamavesi njengokuthi 'What do you mean?' kunokuthi uyakwazi ukuthi uyakwazi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nokusetshenziswa kwesikhathi: nge-English kusetshenziswa isikhathi esidlulileyo ukuze kuhlanganise izinhlelo eziyisikhathi eside, kanti ngesi ngalinye isikhathi kusetshenziswa isikhathi esidlulileyo ukuze kuhlanganise izinhlelo eziyisikhathi eside.
rule: Ukuze ukhulume ngamaphuzu amahlukahlukene nokubhekana kwezinye izinto nge-English ngesikhathi sokuqala, kudingeka ukuqonda: 1) Imibuzo engakaphambili: 'Could you explain that?' kunokuthi 'Explain that'. 2) Izinhloso zokukhuluma ngokwenhlonipho: 'I think', 'I feel', 'I guess' ukuze ungavuni kahle. 3) Imibuzo yokukhakisisa: 'Do you mean...?', 'Are you saying...?' ukuze uqinisekise lokho okwakhulunywa. 4) Ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi esidlulileyo ukuze kuhlanganise izinhlelo eziyisikhathi eside: 'I misunderstood' (hhayi 'I have misunderstood' uma akukho ukuhlangana nesikhathi samanje). Shayisa ukuhumusha ngokwenhloso 'tener razón' (to be right, hhayi 'to have reason') nokuhumusha 'hacer falta' (to need, hhayi 'to make lack').

title: Discussing Environmental Topics / Ukudlulisela ngamalungu okudonsa
bridge: NgesiSpani, ukuze sicazise imisebenzi eyenzeka ngesikhathi esijulile, siyathusa isikhathi esisodwa ('siyadonsa') noma isikhathi esimbalwa ('siyadonsa manje') ngokulinganayo. NgesiNgesi, ukuqamba kulingana nokuthi uyakwenza njani: isikhathi esisodwa ('we pollute') sicazisa izinto eziqhubekayo noma izinhlobo, ngakabe isikhathi esimbalwa ('we are polluting') sicazisa imisebenzi eyenzeka manje. Ngaphambi kwezihloko, ngesiNgesi, ukuze khulume ngemisebenzi eyayaziwe (nje 'We are going to reduce waste'), siyathusa 'be going to' noma isikhathi esimbalwa, ngakabe ngesiSpani siyathusa isikhathi esizayo ('reduciremos'). Khumbula ukusebenzisa 'should' ukuze uqambe ngokuthi uyakwenza njani, ngesiSpani okuqondakalayo ngokuthi 'deberíamos'.
rule: Ukuze uhlale ngamalungu okudonsa ngesiNgesi ehlelo B1, ufanele ukudlula: 1) Isikhathi esisodwa (izinhlobo eziqhubekayo: 'The planet is warming' – ngisho nalapha siyathusa isikhathi esimbalwa ngoba yindlela eyenzeka; kuzo zonke izinhlobo: 'Climate change affects everyone'), 2) Isikhathi esimbalwa (emisebenzi eyenzeka: 'Forests are disappearing'), 3) 'be going to' + isibhalo (izinkolelo zakuze: 'We are going to install solar panels'), futhi 4) 'should' + isibhalo (izinkolelo: 'You should recycle more'). Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgesi, isikhathi esisodwa sicondzakalwa nga '-s' kwabantu abathathu abasodwa (he/she/it). Kuka 'there is/are' (kuna), khumbula ukuthi 'there is' kuba yisodwa, 'there are' kuba yabantu abaningi. Ngaphambi kwezihloko, sebenzisa izinhlobo ezinhlanganisayo njengokuthi 'ngoba', 'ngakho', 'ngakho-ke' ukuze uhlanganise izinhloso. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi amazwana avela phambi kwesibhalo ngesiNgesi ('renewable energy', hhayi 'energy renewable').

examples.original: There is too much plastic waste in the environment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz tuː mʌtʃ ˈplæstɪk weɪst ɪn ðə ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
examples.note: Seyithusa 'there is' nezibhalo eziyingozi njengokuthi 'waste'. Ungasho ukuthi 'there are waste'.

examples.original: Deforestation destroys the habitat of many animals.
examples.phonetic: /ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən dɪˈstrɔɪz ðə ˈhæbɪtæt əv ˈmɛni ˈænɪməlz/
examples.translation: Ukuxhumana komithi kuya kuba yinto eyomuntu wonke.
examples.note: Isikhathi esisodwa kuzo zonke izinhlobo. Khumbula ukuthi '-s' kwabantu abathathu: 'destroys'.

examples.original: We are planting more trees in our neighborhood.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr ˈplæntɪŋ mɔːr triːz ɪn ˈaʊər ˈneɪbərhʊd/
examples.note: Isikhathi esimbalwa kuzo zonke izinhlobo. 'Plant' siyakushintsha ku 'planting'.

examples.original: Our school is going to start a recycling program.
examples.phonetic: /ˈaʊər skuːl ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ˈproʊɡræm/
examples.translation: Isikole sakithi siza kuhla umphumela wokudonsa.
examples.note: Seyithusa 'be going to' kuzo zonke izinkolelo zakuze. Seyakwenza 'is going to' ephambaneni.

examples.original: We should use less electricity to save energy.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ʃʊd juːz lɛs ɪlɛkˈtrɪsɪti tə seɪv ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Sifanele ukusebenzisa amandla amancane ukuze sikhundlele.
examples.note: 'Should' landelana nesibhalo esisodwa (hhayi 'to'). 'Less' kuzo zonke izinhlobo; 'fewer' kuzo zonke izinhlobo.

examples.original: If everyone recycles, we will reduce pollution.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ˈɛvriwʌn riːˈsaɪkəlz, wiː wɪl rɪˈdjuːs pəˈluːʃən/
examples.translation: Uma wonke umuntu uyadonsa, siza kuthinta ukudonsa.
examples.note: Isikhathi esokuqala: 'if' + isikhathi esisodwa, 'will' + isibhalo. 'Everyone' kuya kuba yisodwa.

examples.original: I think that electric cars are a good investment for the future.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ɪˈlɛktrɪk kɑːrz ɑːr ə ɡʊd ɪnˈvɛstmənt fɔːr ðə ˈfjuːtʃər/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izimoto eziyizimbali ziyinto enhle ukuze sikhundlele.
examples.note: Seyithusa 'I think that' kuzo zonke izinhloso. Emva kuka 'think', ukubhala 'that' akusidingekile.

examples.original: In my opinion, recycling should be mandatory in every city.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, riːˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətəri ɪn ˈɛvri ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Ngokwami, ukudonsa kufanele kuba yisidingo kuzo zonke izindawo.
examples.note: Ukucazisa 'in my opinion' + 'should be'. 'Recycling' kuya kuba yisibhalo, ngakho-ke isibhalo esisodwa.

examples.original: The government should invest more in renewable energy sources.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnjuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi ˈsɔːrsɪz/
examples.translation: Ubumbeni kufanele ukusebenzisa amandla amaningi kuzo zonke izinhlobo.
examples.note: Inkolelo ngokuthi 'should'. Amazwana 'renewable' avela phambi kwesibhalo.

examples.original: If we don't stop deforestation, many species will become extinct.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt stɒp ˌdiːfɒrɪˈsteɪʃən, ˈmɛni ˈspiːʃiːz wɪl bɪˈkʌm ɪkˈstɪŋkt/
examples.translation: Uma singaphindi ukuxhumana komithi, izinhlobo ezinengi ziza kufa.
examples.note: Isikhathi esokuqala ngokuthi 'if we don't'. 'Species' kuya kuba yisodwa futhi yabantu abaningi.

title: Talking About Technology and Social Media / Ukuthetha ngokwethu okwesikhombisa kanye nabaleli abaningi
bridge: IsiHispani, sivela ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana ukudonsa izindlela kanye nezimo (ngokwesibonelo, 'manje ngiyakubuka icelaphini'), kodwa ngesiNgisi, isahlukile phakathi kwesikhathi esihambisana kanye nesikhathi esiqhubekayo. Nalo, ukuthetha ngokwethu okwesikhombisa, abantu abathetha isiHispani bavela ukushintsha izinhlelo njengokuthi 'nginakuhola' okanye 'ngiyakuthanda isithombe', kodwa ngesiNgisi sivela ukusebenzisa 'I have to click' okanye 'I like the photo' ngaphandle kwesibhalo esithi 'me'. Khomba indlela abantu abathetha ngayo (njengokuthi 'log in', 'sign up') ongazange ifanele ngokwesikhashana ngesiHispani futhi kunzima ukuzishintsha ngeyezindlu.
rule: Ukuthetha ngokwethu okwesikhombisa kanye nabaleli abaningi ngesiNgisi kwesikhala saseB1, sebenzisa: 1) Isikhathi esihambisana ukudonsa izindlela kanye nezimo (I check my phone every morning). 2) Isikhathi esiqhubekayo ukudonsa izimo eziqhubekayo (I am scrolling through Instagram right now). 3) Amazwi okuthandisa kanye nokwenza: can, should, must (You should update your password). 4) Izinhlelo zabantu abaningi: log in, log out, sign up, turn on, turn off, set up. 5) Izinhlelo nge- 'like' kanye 'share' (I like the post, She shared the video). Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi asiveli ukusebenzisa isibhalo ngaphambi kwesibhalo esithi 'social media' (I spend time on social media, hhayi 'in the social media'). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukudonsa ukubeka kwesikhombisi sivela ukusebenzisa 'have' (I have a new phone) kungekho 'tengo' ngokuthi 'there is'.

concept_examples.text: I usually check my social media in the morning.
concept_examples.translation: Ngokuvamile ngiyabuka abaleli bami abaningi ngenkusasa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli tʃek maɪ ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She is posting a story on Instagram right now.
concept_examples.translation: Yena uyabeka isibonelo esisha ku-Instagram manje.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈpoʊstɪŋ ə ˈstɔːri ɑːn ˈɪnstəɡræm raɪt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: You should log out of your account on public computers.
concept_examples.translation: Kufanele ukhambe ukungena kwakho kwisikhumba ngokwesikhashana kwesikhombisi esiphambili.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd lɔːɡ aʊt əv jʊər əˈkaʊnt ɑːn ˈpʌblɪk kəmˈpjuːtərz/

concept_examples.text: Can you help me set up my new laptop?
concept_examples.translation: Ingabe ungasinceda ukusethupha ikhompyutha elisha lami?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kæn juː hɛlp miː sɛt ʌp maɪ nuː ˈlæptɑːp/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct: I agree with you about social media.
common_error.correct_alt: I agree on that point about social media.
common_error.explanation: IsiHispani sithi 'ngiyakuhola', kodwa ngesiNgisi 'agree' yisibhalo sokudonsa kanye asiveli ukusebenziswa ngendlela ehqhubekayo. Ukuze uqhubeke kulomphutha, khumbula ukuthi 'agree' ayithwali 'be' phambi kwawo. Omunye umphutha oyingozi kakhulu ukuthi 'I am agree', kodwa okusemqoka kungenasipho 'I agree'. Ungasebenzise 'I agree with you' (ngiyakuhola nawe) okanye 'I agree on that' (ngiyakuhola ngalokho).

levels.label: Basic Vocabulary and Phrases for Tech

examples.original: I need to charge my phone.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə tʃɑːrdʒ maɪ foʊn/
examples.note: Isibhalo 'charge' sithetha ukudonsa (ibhetri). IsiHispani ngalinye sivela ukusebenzisa 'cargar' ukudonsa icelaphini, kodwa ngesiNgisi asisithi 'load' kulomsebenzi.

examples.original: My laptop is very slow.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæptɑːp ɪz ˈvɛri sloʊ/
examples.note: Beka emkhathini ukuthi ngesiNgisi 'slow' sivela ukusebenziswa ukudonsa ukusiza kwesikhombisi, njengesiHispani, kodwa ungawafanisi 'late' (tarde).

examples.original: Do you have a charger?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈtʃɑːrdʒər/
examples.note: Ubunye obuqalisiwe kwabantfu. Khumbula ukuthi 'charger' yicelaphini elidonsayo, hhayi 'loader'.

examples.original: I'm scrolling through my feed.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈskroʊlɪŋ θruː maɪ fiːd/
examples.note: Isibhalo 'scroll through' sivela ukusebenziswa ukudonsa ukubuka kwesikrini. IsiHispani sithi 'deslizar' okanye 'hacer scroll', kodwa ngesiNgisi sivela ukusebenzisa 'scroll' njengesibhalo.

examples.original: She uploaded a new video yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ʌpˈloʊdɪd ə nuː ˈvɪdioʊ ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.note: NgesiNgisi 'upload' sivela ukusebenziswa ukudonsa ukubeka isibonelo esisha; isiHispani ngalinye sithi 'subir' kodwa 'montar' kwabanye izindawo. Lapha sivela ukusebenzisa isikhathi esidlulile.

examples.original: He liked my post and commented.
examples.phonetic: /hiː laɪkt maɪ poʊst ænd ˈkɑːmɛntɪd/
examples.note: Beka emkhathini ukuthi ngesiNgisi sithi 'he liked' (hhayi 'he liked it' uma kuhlejelwe) kanye nesibhalo 'like' asithwali isibhalo esingathi 'le' njengesiHispani 'le gustó'.

examples.original: Are you following that influencer?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr juː ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ ðæt ˈɪnfluənsər/
examples.note: Isibhalo 'follow' sivela ukusebenziswa kwabaleli abaningi. IsiHispani ngalinye sivela ukusebenzisa 'seguir' nalo, kodwa ngesiNgisi kunjalo. Beka emkhathini ukusebenzisa kwesikhathi esiqhubekayo ukubuzwa.

levels.label: Discussing Pros and Cons of Social Media

examples.original: Social media can be addictive.
examples.phonetic: /ˈsoʊʃl ˈmiːdiə kæn biː əˈdɪktɪv/
examples.note: Sivela ukusebenzisa isibhalo 'can' ukudonsa umphutha. IsiHispani sithi 'pueden ser', kodwa ngesiNgisi isibhalo esithandisa asiguquli ngokwesabantu.

examples.original: One advantage is that you can connect with people worldwide.
examples.phonetic: /wʌn ədˈvæntɪdʒ ɪz ðæt juː kæn kəˈnɛkt wɪð ˈpiːpəl ˈwɜːrldwaɪd/
examples.translation: Mathuba kukhona ukuthi ungahlanganyela nabantu abavela ezinye izindawo.
examples.note: Lapha sivela ukusebenzisa 'one advantage' ukudonsa umthetho oqondile. IsiHispani sithi 'una ventaja es que', kodwa ngesiNgisi isimo kunjalo.

examples.original: However, it can waste a lot of time.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈɛvər, ɪt kæn weɪst ə lɑːt əv taɪm/
examples.note: Isibhalo 'however' yisibhalo esiqondile. IsiHispani sivela ukusebenzisa 'sin embargo'. Beka emkhathini ukuthi 'waste' sithetha ukudonsa, hhayi ukufanana 'spend' (ukusebenzisa isikhathi).

examples.original: I think it's better to limit screen time.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ˈbɛtər tə ˈlɪmɪt skriːn taɪm/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi kuhle ukudonsa isikhathi sokubuka.

title: Talking about Education and Studying Abroad / Isifundo nokufunda ngaphandle kwelokhu
bridge: NgesisiZulu, ukukhuluma ngemisebenzi esizayo sisebenzisa isikhathi samanje (ngiyofunda) okanye isikhathi esizayo (ngizofunda), kodwa ngesiNgisi kunzima ukusebenzisa isikhathi samanje esiqhubekayo njengokufakaza isizathu esizayo ('I am studying') uma kukhona umqondo owaziwe. Ngaphandle kwalokho, khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi awusho ‘I have 20 years’ kodwa uthi ‘I am 20 years old’. Uma ukhulumela ngokufunda, uzokubona ukuthi amagama asemihlelo nemifanekiso yokufunda awenelanga isihloko esiqondile ngesiNgisi ('I study mathematics'), ngesisiZulu kunjalo ('Ngifunda izifundo zezinkulungwane'). Hlola kancane la madoda ukuze ube nomlomo omuhle.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngesifundo nokufunda ngaphandle kwelokhu ngesiNgisi ehlelo B1, sebenzisa: 1. Isikhathi samanje semisebenzi nemisebenzi yokuzuza ('I study every day'). 2. Isikhathi samanje esiqhubekayo semisebenzi eyenzekayo manje ('I am studying for my exam') nakuba yimisebenzi esizayo eyaziwe ('I am going to England next month'). 3. 'Going to' ukufakaza izinto ezizakwenzeka ('I'm going to apply for a scholarship'). 4. 'Will' ukufakaza izinqumo ezenzakalelwe okanye ukubekezelela ('I think it will be a great experience'). 5. Amagama okungakhetha njengokuthi 'can', 'must', 'should' ukufakaza imisebenzi, izilinganiso nezikhumbuzo ('You should apply early'). 6. Amagama okuqhubeka: 'study at a university', 'apply for a course', 'major in' (ukukhetha isifundo), 'take an exam'. 7. Amagama asemihlelo awenelanga isihloko ('I like history'). 8. Sebenzisa 'abroad' (ngaphandle kwelokhu) ngaphandle komgijo, kodwa 'to study abroad' okanye 'study abroad' njengomgijo okanye isihloko.

Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi kusho 'study at the university' (hhayi 'in the university') ngenxa yokuthi kusetshenziswa 'at' ezikolweni. Hlola kancane la madoda ukuze ube nomlomo omuhle.

examples.original: I think you should go for it.

title: Talking about Past Trips and Travel Experiences / Ukuthetha ngamalungu nokubhuka kwesikhathi esidlulile
bridge: NgisiSpani, ukuthetha ngokubhuka kwesikhathi esidlulile siyaxhamla ipretérit perfèct nangokwesekho, futhi ukwahlukanisa phakathi kuka 'he viajado' nokwa 'viajé' kulinganiselwa yisikhathi. NgisiNgesi, le liqembu lifanayo kodwa ngezemu zokuqonda: ipresent perfèct (have + umthelela) siyaxhamla ukubhuka okungakwazi ukuba lisekelwe isikhathi esiyisiqingatha, ngakho-ke ipast simple (viajé) siyaxhamla imisebenzi ekweni elisekelwe isikhathi esiyisiqingatha sesikhathi esidlulile. Umphutha oyingozi kakhulu ukusebenzisa ipast simple esikhundleni sopresent perfèct lapho sisabuza '¿Has estado alguna vez...?', ngenxa yokuthi isiSpani siyaxhamla 'has estado' kodwa ngisiNgesi siyadinga 'have you ever been'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngisiNgesi amazwi okungabonakalanga njengokuba 'go/went/gone' nokuba 'see/saw/seen' adinga ukukhumbulwa, futhi abafundi abathetha isiSpani bayeniza ukucwaninga 'been' no 'gone': 'have been' iculinga ukuya futhi ubuye, ngakho-ke 'have gone' iculinga ukuthi 'usekhona khona manje'.
rule: Ukuthetha ngokubhuka kwesikhathi esidlulile ngisiNgesi kwesikhasi sika B1, udinga amaxesha amabili: ipresent perfèct (have/has + umthelela wesikhathi esidlulile) no past simple (isibhalo somsebenzi kwesikhathi esidlulile). Sebenzisa ipresent perfèct ukuba: 1) ukubhuka okungakwazi ukuba lisekelwe isikhathi esiyisiqingatha (I have visited Paris), 2) ngezimali njengokuba 'ever', 'never', 'already', 'yet' (Have you ever been to Japan?), 3) imisebenzi eyathetha kwesikhathi esidlulile futhi isezakhiwe (I have lived here for three years). Sebenzisa ipast simple ukuba: 1) imisebenzi eyekelwe kwesikhathi esiyisiqingatha kwesikhathi esidlulile (I visited Paris last summer), 2) ngezimali zosikhathi njengokuba 'yesterday', 'in 2019', 'last week', 'when I was a child'. Amazwi okungabonakalanga amaningi ukubhuka: go-went-gone, see-saw-seen, eat-ate-eaten, take-took-taken, fly-flew-flown, ride-rode-ridden, drive-drove-driven, stay-stayed-stayed (okomthetho). Isimo sombuzo ngopresent perfèct: Have/Has + inombolo + umthelela? (Have you ever flown first class?). Iziphendulo eziphothiyile: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Ngopast simple: Did + inombolo + isibhalo somsebenzi? (Did you go to the beach?). Iziphendulo eziphothiyile: Yes, I did / No, I didn't. Nge 'ever' no 'never' siyaxhamla ipresent perfèct, hhayi ipast simple: 'I have never been to Mexico' (hhayi 'I never went to Mexico' lapho ukubhuka kweqembu). Ungasebenzisi 'since' nendawo yokuphela kwesikhathi esidlulile (I have visited Spain since 2018 - okungahleli ukuba akusezakhiwe), sebenzisa 'since' nokusindwa komsebenzi (I have been in Spain since 2018). Khumbula ukuthi amazwi okuthandeka (amazing, terrible, wonderful, boring) ayaxhamlwa nge 'was/were' ngopast simple ukudonsa ukubhuka.

concept_examples.text: I have been to London twice.

title: Talking about habits and routines / Khuluma ngamalungelo namasiko
bridge: Ngesiporutheni, siyaxhoma ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana ukukhuluma ngamalungelo, njengenkathi yisiNgisi, kodwa kunezahlukahluku ezibalulekile: ngesiNgisi, isikhathi esihambisana siyacela umshiyelo 'do/does' ukuze yekelelahleke futhi buze, ngesiporutheni siyaxhoma ukusebenzisa 'no' noma ukubuyiselwa ngaphandle komshiyelo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, amazwi okwenza ukuba (always, usually, etc.) awufakwe ngaphambi kwezikhombisi ezikhulu, kodwa emva kwezikhombisi 'to be', okungenzeka ngesiPorutheni. Qaphela 's' kwesithathu (he/she/it), okungokuvulekile ukuyilibala abakhuluma isiPorutheni.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngamalungelo namasiko ngesiNgisi, kusetshenziswa isikhathi esihambisana. Ngosethu lwesithathu (he, she, it), kungezwa -s noma -es ezihlobonini (e.g., 'works', 'goes'). Ukuze yekelelahleke, kusetshenziswa 'do not' (don't) noma 'does not' (doesn't) + izikhombisi ezimisa. Ukubuzwa, kusetshenziswa 'do' noma 'does' ekuqaleni, kulandele umphathi nezikhombisi ezimisa. Amazwi okwenza ukuba (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) awufakwe: (1) ngaphambi kwezikhombisi ezikhulu (I always drink coffee), (2) emva kwezikhombisi 'to be' (He is always late), futhi (3) phakathi komshiyelo nezikhombisi kubuzwa nokuyekelelahleka (Do you often exercise?). Izibopho: nezihlobonini 'have' njengomshiyelo owethu, kusetshenziswa 'have/has' (I have breakfast at 8). Nezihlobonini 'go' futhi 'do', osethu lwesithathu luhlehliselwa 'goes' futhi 'does'. Imisebenzi ekuhambeni manje, ungasetshenziswa isikhathi esihambisana; usebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana.

title: Making Plans and Invitations / Ukwenza Izinkomba Nokubiza
bridge: NgisiNgisi, ukwenza izinkomba nokubiza sikusebenzisa izinhlelo ezifana ne 'would you like to...?' okanye 'how about...?', okungakhethekanga ngokucacile ngesiHispania. Nanjengoko kune amazwi athathwe kanye njengokuthi 'hang out' ezinomthelela kakhulu ezikhombisweni ezingasemingeni. Khumbula ukuthi iNgisiNgisi isebenzisa isikhathi esimbi ukwenza izinkomba ezizayo (I'm meeting) ngakho-ke isiHispania ngalinye isikhathi isebenzisa isikhathi esihle (Quedo).
rule: Ukuze ubize sikusebenzisa: 'Would you like to + verb?' (okomthetho) okanye 'Do you want to + verb?' (engasemingeni). Ukuze usekele: 'How about + gerund?' okanye 'What about + gerund?'. Ukuze uvume: 'Sure', 'Sounds good', 'I'd love to'. Ukuze uphendule: 'I'm afraid I can't', 'Sorry, I have other plans'. Ukuze wenze izinkomba ezizayo, sikusebenzisa isikhathi esimbi (I'm meeting my friends tomorrow) okanye 'going to' (I'm going to visit my sister). Umzuzu 'hang out' uthi ukudlala ngokuthula nabangani. Qaphela ukungahluleki ngokucacile '¿Quedamos?' njengokuthi 'Are we staying?', okwahluleki kulesi 'Shall we meet?' okanye 'Let's meet up'.

title: Giving a short presentation / Ukupresenta oqhelekile
bridge: NesiNgisi, siyathemba ukuxelela izincazelo ngendlela engakazi ngakumbi nangokusiya izibopho eziphindekile. KuloMzulu, ukuze upresente ulwazi ngokucacile nokucacile, kusetshenziswa izibopho eziqondile nokubambisana okwakhiwe. Uyahlulelo oluyiqembu yikuthi nesiNgisi kusetshenziswa isikhathi esihle ngokuxoxa izinto nezincazelo kanye noku 'going to' noma 'will' ukuze kuxoxwe ngemiphumela emuva, ngakube nesiZulu ngasinye isikhathi esisebenzisa isikhathi esihle noma esizayo ngokwahlukanisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amathulusi okuxoxa nesiNgisi (nje njengo 'firstly', 'in addition', 'to sum up') ayiqembu ukusekwa kwesipresente, ngakube nesiZulu siyathemba ukusebenzisa amabambisana njengo 'okuqala', 'ngokumeshane', 'ukubeka ngokucacile'.
rule: Ukupresenta oqhelekile nesiNgisi, landela lesi sethula: 1) Ukwamukela nokupresenta umxhaka (nje njengo 'Good morning, I'm going to talk about...'), 2) Ukusekwa kwezincazelo ngokubambisana (firstly, secondly, in addition, however), 3) Isiphetho (to conclude, in summary). Setha isikhathi esihle ngokuxoxa izinto nezincazelo, kanye noku 'going to' noma 'will' ukuze kuxoxwe ngemiphumela emuva noma izincazelo. Shayisa ukusetshenziswa kwenguquko engakazi kakubi nokusetshenzisa izibopho eziqondile kodwa eziqondile. Izikhalo nokubona ngokweqembu kuhluleka, kodwa kulolwazi, setha izibopho njengo 'Let me start by...', 'Moving on to...', 'To wrap up...'.

concept_examples.text: In addition, it saves energy and natural resources.
concept_examples.translation: Ngokweshumi, kusindisa amandla noma izinsombululo eziphilile.

common_error.correct_alt: Good morning, I'm going to talk about the importance of recycling.

NesiNgisi, kunokunikeza inceku 'to be' ngesikhathi esihle ('I am') ngaphambi 'going to'. Ngaphezu kwalokho, nesiNgisi akusetshenziswa ishloko 'the' nezibopho eziqondile njengo 'recycling' (sikhuluma ngamacebo angakazi ngeshloko). Ukubuyisisa, khumbula ukubeka 'am/is/are' futhi ungasetshenzisi 'the' ngaphambi nezibopho eziqondile.

examples.note: Ukwamukela okwakhiwe ukuvula ukupresenta. Kuyiqembu ukusetshenzisa 'everyone' ukuze kubekezele kabanzi.

examples.original: Another important point is that...
examples.phonetic: /əˈnʌðər ɪmˈpɔːrtənt pɔɪnt ɪz ðæt/
examples.note: Ukuahlula ukubeka ulwazi. Kuyisibonelo esisebenzisekayo ukuze kuhlekelwe amabambisana.

examples.original: However, we must consider the costs.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈevər wi mʌst kənˈsɪdər ðə kɔːsts/
examples.note: 'However' kubeka inceku ehlukanisayo. NesiZulu siyasetshenzisa 'kodwa', okungakazi.

examples.original: In conclusion, I'd like to summarize the main points.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn kənˈkluːʒən aɪd laɪk tə ˈsʌməraɪz ðə meɪn pɔɪnts/
examples.translation: Ukuqedwa, ngifisa ukubeka ngokucacile amacebo amaqembu.
examples.note: Isibopho esiqondile ukuvula ukuphepha. 'In conclusion' kuyiqembu, kodwa kungenani 'to sum up' ezinye izikhathi.

examples.original: To wrap up, remember that every small action counts.
examples.phonetic: /tə ræp ʌp rɪˈmembər ðæt ˈevri smɔːl ˈækʃən kaʊnts/
examples.translation: Ukuqedwa, khumbulani ukuthi yonke into encane iyasebenza.
examples.note: 'To wrap up' yisibopho esingakazi kodwa esiqondile ukuqedwa. Setha ngokwezikhathi.

examples.original: Thank you for your attention.
examples.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔːr jʊər əˈtenʃən/
examples.note: Ukubonga okuqedwa okuningi. NesiNgisi kusetshenziswa 'your attention' (ukubekezela kwakho), hhayi 'your time' kulomxhaka.
